description: Product recall check (US): has a product or brand been recalled? Searches CPSC consumer product recalls and FDA food, drug and medical device enforcement reports (openFDA) in one call; returns hazard or reason, remedy, date, FDA recall class and agency link. Use for product safety, e-commerce listing and procurement checks. Signed receipt. Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"q":"stroller","source":"cpsc"}.
name: product_recalls_us

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: CPSC and FDA recall records: product, hazard or reason, remedy, date, class, agency link

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: US Product Recalls CPSC FDA
